knobs.note: BH-5670: the Mergify application key the lane reads merge-queue/status with. Lives in env/global.env on the hub only. Unset or not token-shaped = the lane logs not-configured and sends nothing. A credential: NOT settable from the control plane.
BH-5670: the Mergify API base. Empty = https://api.mergify.com/v1, the documented fallback in the script. A host the token is sent to: NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: epoch seconds that replace the rotation clock. Honoured only under HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 and only when it is all digits. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam gate: bin/merge-queue-reconcile.sh honours MQR_NOW only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
